verdict.rationale: Before a run, Undermind asks follow-up questions to pin down what the researcher needs, which shapes scope (undermind-docs-37, corroborated by undermind-comm-5 and undermind-comm-8). Resubmitting a similar search continues from existing results, a limited way to extend a run (undermind-docs-41). However, the deep review plans its own searches and stops on its own when new searches stop finding relevant papers (undermind-docs-16), and the filters in undermind-docs-33 apply to the separate quick search tool, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: explicit depth/effort controls (e.g., run length, exhaustiveness or compute budget), user-set scope parameters on the deep research run itself, any ability to steer a run while it executes, independent corroboration of user-controlled depth.
